channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Chipotle: Free entree with purchase of 2 entrees (code SUNDAYS)
item.guid: Chipotle-Free entree with purchase of 2 entrees (-2026-09-06
item.description: Order two or more entrees after 3pm today on the Chipotle app or website and get a third entree free with code SUNDAYS, the last of three Chipotle Sundays this back-to-school run. (Through September 6, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Clean Juice: Free 16oz smoothie with $15 purchase
item.description: Get a free 16oz smoothie automatically applied at checkout when you spend $15 or more online or in the app through September 7. (South & East only) (Through Sept 7, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Panera Bread: 15% off catering orders of $200 or more
item.guid: Panera Bread-15% off catering orders of $200 or more-2026-09-06
item.description: Save 15 percent, up to $100, on a single catering order of $200 or more using code BTS15 online or in store. (Through Sept 11, 2026)

item.title: Walmart: $9.97 rotisserie chicken family meal bundle
item.guid: Walmart-$9.97 rotisserie chicken family meal bun-2026-09-06
item.description: Deli hot-case bundle pairs a whole rotisserie chicken with two large sides like mac and cheese or mashed potatoes for $9.97, ready to eat. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chili's: 3 For Me combo from $10.99
item.description: Pick a non-alcoholic drink, a starter, and a full entree like the Big Smasher Burger for one flat price starting at $10.99, available all day every day, no app or sign-up required. (Ongoing)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: $5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value Menu
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-$5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value M-2026-09-06
item.description: A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Sub of the Day 6 inch for $4.99
item.guid: Subway-Sub of the Day 6 inch for $4.99-2026-09-06
item.description: A different featured six-inch sub is $4.99 every day of the week as part of Subway's Fresh Value Menu; today's Sunday special is the Spicy Italian. (Ongoing)

item.title: Noodles & Company: Delicious Duos: Entree + Side from $9.95
item.guid: Noodles & Company-Delicious Duos: Entree + Side from $9.95-2026-09-06
item.description: A small entree paired with a side (garden salad, Caesar, or lemon parmesan broccoli) from $9.95, or chef-curated duos with protein at $10.95, all day every day at participating locations. Price varies slightly by location. (Ongoing)

item.title: Qdoba: $2 off digital orders with Queso Fundido (code FUNDIDO)
item.guid: Qdoba-$2 off digital orders with Queso Fundido-2026-09-06
item.description: Get $2 off any digital order on the Qdoba app or website that includes the new Queso Fundido dip using code FUNDIDO, the last day of this launch promo. (Through September 6, 2026)

item.title: Jason's Deli: Dr Pepper for $1 with code DOLLARDP
item.guid: Jason's Deli-Dr Pepper for $1 with code DOLLARDP-2026-09-06
item.description: Get a Dr Pepper fountain drink for just $1 at Jason's Deli when you enter promo code DOLLARDP at online or in-app checkout, pair it with a sandwich or salad bar visit. (South & Central only) (Limited time)
